title: Morgan says Brown was CIA research

tellings.quote: Morgan has told Paul that Townsend was basically CIA research.

plain: The work of Townsend Brown, a scientist who is said to have built flying-saucer-like devices from the 1950s on, was "basically CIA research," meaning it was secretly backed by the CIA, the US spy agency. Jan Lundquist passes this on in a documentary about Brown on Michels's show. She says a person named Morgan told it to Paul Schatzkin, a writer who has researched Brown's life. If true, Brown's strange experiments were government-backed spy work.
